status: partial historical model profile; architecture reference only

guidance_computer.note: Apollo 11 1201/1202 Executive-overflow meanings, software-restart behavior, and P63/P64 restart protection are source-backed; exact real-time workload state, display path, and complete alarm-response rule set remain incomplete.

backup_guidance.note: Apollo 11 powered-descent monitoring source pairs and several component limits are now source-bounded in a dedicated historical guidance-monitoring profile: AGS-PGNS and powered-flight-processor/PGNS in-plane comparisons use 10-fps radial/downrange problem/isolation limits; PFP/PGNS PGNS-failure limits are 35 fps radial and 30 fps downrange; AGS-PGNS crossrange problem detection uses 20 fps. Generic comparison machinery is implemented. Historical freshness/update cadence, exact attitude limits, remaining crossrange/misalignment thresholds, controller presentation, and complete decision rules remain unresolved, so the profile is intentionally non-executable.

landing_radar.note: Apollo 11 radar-good/update-enable/velocity-update chronology is sourced. Generic update gating and a separate generic measurement-qualification layer are implemented. Apollo 11 profile data now captures 4-s Data Good persistence, 1-s range-scale stability, 50,000-ft range-update altitude boundary, 2,000-ft/s velocity-update speed boundary, astronaut approval requirement, and source-shaped affine residual rules. LM-5 beam/terrain measurement generation, exact radar-axis reference computation, estimator weighting/filter equations, processing cadence, and controller presentation remain unresolved.

propulsion.note: Generic variable-thrust machinery exists, but Apollo 11 LM-5 powered-descent thrust/mass-flow profile and historical acceptance inputs are not yet frozen for this reference interval.

translational_dynamics.note: Generic central-gravity propagation exists, but Apollo 11 descent frame, initial state, lunar gravity/perturbation scope, thrust-direction coupling, and validation tolerance are not yet frozen.

controller_observation.note: Alarm chronology and selected controller/crew communications are documented; exact GUIDO display fields, update cadence, and independent PGNS/AGS/radar observation products remain incomplete.

guidance_monitoring.note: Apollo 11 powered-descent monitoring used PGNCS, AGS, and MSFN-derived velocity with a documented two-out-of-three comparison topology. Generic multi-source consensus machinery is implemented. Existing source-specific pairwise limits remain in the historical guidance-monitoring profile. Observation freshness/update cadence, exact phase/source-pair applicability, MSFN powered-flight processing, controller presentation, and operational response rules remain unresolved, so this domain is non-executable.
